name: Jullien Guce
intro: Campaign concepts and visuals across digital, print, and animation.
bio:
An art director and graphic designer with over 10 years of experience in advertising and design. I develop campaign concepts and visuals across digital, print, and animation.

Currently a Brand Visualizer Manager, I guide visual direction and support the design team while staying involved in creating the work. I enjoy collaborating on ideas and exploring new tools, including AI, as part of my creative process.

projects.title: Integrated Campaigns for Samsung Philippines
projects.summary: Selected work across Mobile and Digital Appliances, spanning product launches, seasonal promotions, and key visuals. Work includes visual development to local adaptations across digital, retail, and outdoor materials.
projects.challenge: Bring Samsung’s product stories and promotions to the Philippine market while maintaining its premium identity across different channels.
projects.solution: Developed and adapted campaign visuals across digital, animation, retail, and outdoor placements with a consistent visual direction and clear message hierarchy.

projects.title: Tefal Holiday Sale Campaign
projects.summary: Developed the visual direction for Tefal’s Holiday Sale Campaign and adapted it across multiple customer touchpoints.
projects.challenge: Create a festive holiday campaign that drives seasonal purchases while maintaining a strong and recognizable Tefal brand presence across e-commerce channels.
projects.solution: A flexible e-commerce campaign system for Lazada and Shopee that keeps products clear, promos easy to read, and visuals consistent across all holiday sale assets.

media.title: Holiday key visual, marketplace banners, and product imagery

projects.title: HP 3.3 Mega Shopping Campaign
projects.summary: Created campaign visuals for HP’s 3.3 Sale across Lazada and Shopee, highlighting promotions, product categories, and featured deals.
projects.challenge: Create a 3.3 campaign for HP that attracts shoppers during the sale event and clearly presents promotions across different product categories.
projects.solution: Designed a campaign that combines promotional offers, product categories, and featured deals into a simple and easy-to-navigate shopping experience.

projects.title: Flash Express Brand Campaign
projects.summary: Led and executed brand visuals across social media and marketing campaigns, creating content that strengthened brand presence and customer connection.
projects.challenge: Create engaging marketing visuals for Flash Express across digital, print, and on-ground channels while maintaining a consistent brand identity.
projects.solution: Designed cohesive brand assets that delivered a consistent brand experience across every customer touchpoint.

media.title: Campaign key visuals, marketing materials, and company profile

projects.title: Bringing Oktoberfest Across the Philippines
projects.summary: Created campaign visuals for San Miguel Oktoberfest across social, digital, OOH, and event materials, supporting nationwide event promotion and real-time coverage.
projects.challenge: Turn Oktoberfest into a nationwide celebration that felt relevant to different audiences across the Philippines, while giving San Miguel a meaningful way to connect with its consumers.
projects.solution: We built the campaign around “SALAMAT,” turning Oktoberfest into San Miguel’s way of giving back. The idea was carried across regional events, digital content, promotions, and on-ground executions to create one connected celebration across the country.

media.title: Teaser, launch, live coverage, and sustaining campaign

projects.title: Building Dry Eye Awareness Through Screen Time
projects.summary: Developed the campaign concept and visuals for Systane Ultra Eyedurance, raising awareness of Dry Eye Syndrome through digital content and media.
projects.challenge: People spend hours in front of screens every day. While they know prolonged screen use can affect their eyes, giving up their devices isn’t realistic. The challenge was to raise awareness of Dry Eye Syndrome in a way that felt relevant to their screen-driven lifestyle.
projects.solution: We created Systane Ultra Eyedurance, a digital campaign that used people’s screen time to educate them about Dry Eye Syndrome. Onscreen ads highlighted symptoms and connected prolonged screen use to dry eye, supported by social content, native articles, videos, and search.

media.title: Social, native content, search, display, and case study
